hero.headline: Frontend Software Engineer | React, Next.js, TypeScript | Design Systems, Web Performance, REST APIs & Node.js
hero.bio: Frontend Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building fast, maintainable production web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Government portals, real-time data platforms, and AI agent training environments for clients including Microsoft and Amazon — with 3+ years of remote delivery in English for distributed US teams.
hero.available: Open to full-time remote (US, EU, Brazil)

cpqd.shot: Illustration — voice biometrics over government documents
description: Cut a 2,200-item icon picker's open time from 1,756 ms to 136 ms and raised filtering frame rate from 30 to 60 FPS (worst frame 491 ms to 45 ms) by virtualizing rows with TanStack Virtual and moving per-item styling out of the CSS-in-JS runtime (measured under 4x CPU throttling).

Reduced screen load time from 5.4 s to 2.2 s (QA-verified; 10-image payload dropped from 4,952 kB to 809 kB) by converting pasted images to WebP in the browser, compressing uploads, and lazy-rendering rich text.
Delivered a real-time voice biometrics UI that earned the highest client satisfaction score in the portfolio, building the React interface over a live WebSocket stream with real-time charting.
Sustained 85%+ automated test coverage on critical flows by designing a layered test strategy (Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright) wired into Jenkins CI/CD.

Contributed reusable components to the corporate Design System and packaged a standalone 25-component library (light/dark themes, Storybook) for an external partner team after stripping internal auth and API exposure.

Defined REST API contracts with backend engineers, proposed a Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer, unblocked OIDC/SSO user provisioning in Nextcloud via authenticated WebDAV requests, and built WCAG-accessible interfaces for Portal DestaquesGovBr (MGI / INSPIRE).

Host of the Frontend Chapter (recurring technical sessions and mentoring) and led AI-assisted coding adoption (Claude Code, Cursor) on a client project, including an internal talk and moderating the company's AI roundtable.

Built and shipped production React and Next.js interfaces for AI agent training platforms used by enterprise clients including Microsoft and Amazon, working in an asynchronous, distributed US engineering team.
Co-led projects end-to-end alongside the tech lead — breaking requirements into scoped tasks, coordinating delivery across developers, and owning progress reporting in the lead's absence.
Shortened development cycle time under tight deadlines by introducing AI-assisted engineering workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) and documenting team-wide code-review conventions.
Collaborated daily in English (written and live) with designers, product stakeholders, and engineers across US time zones.
Reduced application load time by ~90% by diagnosing redundant third-party API calls as the primary bottleneck and building a Node.js API caching layer to centralize integrations.

Led the full frontend rebuild of a legacy e-commerce analytics platform in React, TypeScript, and Redux as sole frontend developer, defining project structure, component patterns, and data-fetching architecture from scratch.
Built a responsive operational dashboard with interactive charts (ApexCharts), large filterable tables, and URL-driven pagination over live multi-marketplace data.
Designed REST endpoints normalizing responses from multiple marketplace providers into a single frontend contract.

cpqdIntern.shot: Illustration — billing and debt-negotiation ledger module
description: Developed the billing and debt-negotiation module of an enterprise Billing platform across its full lifecycle, from initial scaffolding to production sign-off, using React, TypeScript, Redux, and Material UI.
Practiced pair programming and rigorous code reviews alongside requirements analysts, UX designers, and backend engineers to maintain code quality and minimize rework.
Built responsive, cross-browser web interfaces with React, JavaScript, SCSS, and Material UI directly from design prototypes in a cross-functional product team.
Extended the product to mobile by shipping a cross-platform React Native app with workout-management features for fitness trainers.
